source: Confucius said: There are seventy-seven disciples who have studied with me and become proficient in the six arts. They are all people with extraordinary talents. Outstanding in virtue: Yan Yuan, Min Ziqian, Ran Boniu, Zhong Gong. Those who are good at handling political affairs: Ran You, Ji Lu. In terms of language: Zaiwo, Zigong. Articles on erudition: Ziyou, Zixia. Master Zhuan Sun was extreme, Zeng Shen was slow, Gao Chai was stupid, Zhong You was rude, and Yan Hui was often poor and had nothing. Duanmuci did not accept the mercy of fate and went into business, but his predictions on the market were often accurate. The people whom Confucius respected: in the Zhou Dynasty, it was Laozi; in the Wei Kingdom, it was Zang Boyu; in the Qi Kingdom, it was Yan Zhongping; in the Chu Kingdom, it was Laolaizi; in the Zheng Kingdom, it was Zichan; in the Lu Kingdom, it was Meng Gongchuo. He also often praised Zang Wenzhong, Liu Xiahui, Tongtan Bohua, and Jieshan Ziran. Confucius was born later than them and was not of the same era. Yan Hui was from the state of Lu, his courtesy name was Ziyuan. Thirty years younger than Confucius. Yan Yuan asked what benevolence was, and Confucius said: Restrain yourself and make your words and deeds conform to etiquette, and people in the world will praise you as a virtuous person. Confucius said: Yan Hui! What a virtuous person! He ate a small bamboo basket of rice, drank a ladle of water, and lived in a simple alley. Most people couldn't bear this kind of hardship, but Yan Hui didn't change his joy. When he was listening to my teachings, Yan Hui seemed like a stupid person. After class, I examined his private conversations and showed that he was able to express himself deliberately. Yan Hui was really not stupid. When you are employed, you will save the world; when you are not employed, you will hide your secrets. Only you and I have such an attitude towards life! Yan Hui was only twenty-nine years old, his hair turned completely white, and he died prematurely. Confucius cried very sadly and said: Since I had Yan Hui, the students have become closer and closer to me. Duke Ai of Lu asked: Who among the students is the best at learning? Confucius replied: There is a man named Yan Hui who had better learn from others and never transfer his anger to others and never make the same mistake again. Unfortunately, life was short, and after death, there are no such people anymore. Min Sun, also known as Ziqian, was fifteen years younger than Confucius. Confucius said: Min Ziqian is too filial! He serves his parents and obeys his brothers. Others praise him without any criticism.

He noted individual traits: Zhuan Sun was extreme, Zeng Shen slow, Gao Chai stupid, Zhong You rude, and Yan Hui poor. Zigong, rejecting fate, became a successful merchant. Confucius respected figures like Laozi, Zang Boyu, Yan Zhongping, Laolaizi, Zichan, and Meng Gongchuo, and praised others from earlier eras. Yan Hui (Yan Yuan), thirty years younger than Confucius, was praised for virtue, living frugally without changing his joy. Confucius said he restrained himself to conform to etiquette, was not stupid, and shared a philosophy of serving when employed and hiding when not. Yan Hui died prematurely at twenty-nine, causing Confucius great grief. Duke Ai of Lu was told Yan Hui was the best learner, never transferring anger or repeating mistakes.

He serves his parents and obeys his brothers. Others praise him without any criticism. He does not want to be a retainer of a high official, and he does not want to receive a salary from an emperor. So he said: If someone calls me again, I will definitely flee to the north of Wenshui River. Ran Geng, courtesy name Boniu. Confucius thought he was virtuous. Boniu was suffering from an incurable disease. Confucius went to greet him, shook his hand from the window, and said: This is life! Such a good person got such a disease, what a fate! Ran Yong, courtesy name Zhong Gong. Zhong Gong asked how to handle political affairs. Confucius said: When going out to do things, be as courteous and courteous as receiving distinguished guests, and use the people as piously and cautiously as hosting a grand ceremony. In this way, no one will resent you if you serve in the feudal state of a prince, and no one will resent you if you serve in the home of a high official. Confucius thought that Zhong Gong had achieved great achievements in virtue and said: Ran Yong, you can make him a high official like a senior official. Zhong Gong's father was a man of humble status. Confucius used an analogy and said: A mottled cow gives birth to a red calf with round and straight horns. Even if you don't want to use it as a sacrifice, will the gods of the mountains and rivers abandon it? Ran Qiu, also known as Zi You, was twenty-nine years younger than Confucius. As the head of Li family's retainers. Ji Kangzi asked Confucius: Is Ran Qiu virtuous? Confucius replied: There is a city with a thousand households and a fief with a hundred chariots. Ran Qiu can manage the military and political affairs there well. As for whether he is benevolent or not, I don't know. Ji Kangzi asked again: Is Zilu virtuous? Confucius replied: Just like Ran Qiu. Ran Qiu asked Confucius: Do you act immediately when you hear what you should do? Confucius replied: Act immediately. Zilu asked Confucius: When you hear something you should do, should you act immediately? Confucius replied: How can you act immediately when you hear something when your father and brothers are here? Zihua felt that this was strange and said in confusion: "I boldly ask, why do you ask the same question but get different answers?" Confucius replied: Ran Qiu was timid and worried, so I encouraged him. Zhong Yu has the courage of two people to do things, so I have to restrain him. Zhong Yuan, named Zi Lu, was from Bian. Nine years younger than Confucius. Zilu had a rough temperament, liked to show off his strength, had a strong ambition, and was straightforward. He wore a rooster-style hat and a sword decorated with boar skin. He once bullied Confucius. Confucius slowly induced him with ritual music. Later, Zilu dressed in Confucian clothes and brought a gift for apprenticeship. Through the recommendation of Confucius's students, Zilu asked to be Confucius's student.

In one year, the old millet is eaten, the new millet matures, and the wood for drilling and making fire is replaced. It is enough to mourn for one year. Confucius passed by Wucheng and heard the sound of playing the harp and singing. Confucius smiled slightly and said: Why use a knife to kill a chicken? Ziyou: Once upon a time, I heard my husband say: Talented people who learn rituals and music will cultivate their benevolence and love the people; ordinary people who learn rituals and music will abide by laws and regulations and be easy to control. Confucius said to the accompanying students: Everyone, what Yan Yan said is correct. What I just said was just a joke. Confucius believed that Ziyou was familiar with articles and erudite. Bu Shang, courtesy name Zixia. Forty-four years younger than Confucius. Zixia asked: "The beautiful smile is charming and moving, the bright eyes are flowing and shining, and the pure white hair of the Buddha is dyed with brilliant literary colors. What do these three sentences mean?" Confucius replied: Painting must first have a pure white background, and then decorate the picture with color. Zixia said: Did the emergence of ritual and music come after benevolence and righteousness? Confucius said: Fortune teller, now I can discuss the Book of Songs with you. After the death of Confucius, Zixia settled in Hexi to teach students and became the teacher of Wei Wenhou. Zixia's son died, and he cried his eyes out. source: The words are not neat and the characters are cheap. Thirty years younger than Confucius. Confucius talked about Mi Zi Jian and said: Zi Jian is really a gentleman! If there are no gentlemen in the state of Lu, where did this person learn such good character? Zi Jian was appointed as Shanfu's local governor. He came back and reported to Confucius, saying: "There are five people in this place who are more talented than me. They taught me how to govern the people." Confucius said: What a pity! The areas that are not managed uniformly are too small. If the areas that are managed are large, it will be almost the same. Yuan Xian, courtesy name Zisi. Zisi asked what shame was. Confucius said: If the country's politics are clear, you can be an official and receive a salary, but you can't see trees. The country's politics are dark, and it is a shame to be an official and receive a salary but not be able to stand alone. Zisi said: If competitiveness, self-praising, resentment, and greed are not revealed, can it be regarded as benevolence? Confucius said: It can be said to be commendable. Whether it can be regarded as benevolence, I don't know. After Confucius passed away, Yuan Xian went to live in seclusion in a low-lying place with water and overgrown weeds. Zigong became the Prime Minister of Wei State, and there was a continuous stream of carriages and horses when he went out, pushing through the thick weeds, and came to a remote, simple and dilapidated hut to visit Yuan Xian. Yuan Xian tidied up his shabby clothes and met Zigong. Seeing this, Zigong felt ashamed for him and said, "Are you embarrassed?" Yuan Xian replied: I have heard that those who have no property are called poverty, and those who have learned principles but cannot implement them are called embarrassment. Like me, poverty is not embarrassment. Zigong felt very ashamed and left unhappy. He felt ashamed for his whole life that he had said the wrong thing this time. Gongye Chang was a native of Qi State, with the courtesy name Zichang. Confucius said: If Gong Ye is the leader, you can marry your daughter to him. Even if he is in prison, it is not his fault. He married his daughter to him. Nangong Kuo, courtesy name Zirong. Nangong Kuo asked Confucius: Yi is good at archery and Yi is good at rowing, but neither of them can end well; how can Yu and Ji cultivate the world by themselves?

source: The king of Nanyue, Wei Tuo, was from Zhending and his surname was Zhao. The Qin State annexed the six countries, captured and pacified Yang Yue, established Guilin, Nanhai and Xiangjun, and resettled the people who had committed crimes and migrated to these places, and lived together with the Yue people for thirteen years. Wei Tuo was appointed as the magistrate of Longchuan County in Nanhai County during the Qin Dynasty. During the second year of Qin Dynasty, Ren Xiao, the captain of Nanhai County, fell ill and was about to die. He summoned Zhao Tuo, the commander of Longchuan, and said to him: I heard that Chen Sheng and others had launched a rebellion, and that the Qin Dynasty was pursuing cruel and unjust policies, and the people of the world were resentful of this. Xiang Yu, Liu Bang, Chen Sheng, Wu Guang, etc. all gathered people in their respective states and counties at the same time, formed armies, and fought for the world like tigers. The Central Plains region was in turmoil, and it was unknown when peace would be restored. Heroes betrayed the Qin Dynasty and opposed each other. Nanhai County is remote and remote, and I am afraid that the bandit army will invade the land. When I attack here, I want to mobilize the army to cut off the newly built road to the Central Plains. I have taken precautions in advance and wait for the changes in the princes. It happens that I am seriously ill. Let’s talk about Panyu. There are dangerous mountains behind us to rely on, and there is the sea as a barrier to the south. It is thousands of miles away from east to west. We have some Central Plains people to assist us. We can also be the lord of a state and establish a country. There is no one among the governors of Nanhai County who is worthy of me to study these things with him, so I have summoned you to tell you these things. Ren Xiao immediately issued an appointment document to Zhao Tuo, asking him to act on behalf of Nanhai County. After Ren Xiao died, Zhao Tuo sent a message to Hengpu, Yangshan, and Huangxiguan, saying: The bandit army is coming, so we must quickly cut off the road, gather the army, and defend ourselves. Zhao Tuo took this opportunity to gradually use the law to kill the officials installed by the Qin Dynasty, and use his cronies as acting governors. After the Qin Dynasty was destroyed, Zhao Tuo attacked and annexed Guilin and Xiangjun, and established himself as King Wu of South Vietnam. Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty had already pacified the world. Because the people in the Central Plains were tired and miserable, Emperor Gaozu of the Han Dynasty spared Zhao Tuo and did not kill him. In the eleventh year of Emperor Gao of the Han Dynasty, he sent Lu Jia to South Vietnam and ordered Zhao Tuo to inherit his title of King of South Vietnam, make an agreement with him, exchange envoys, and let him coordinate Baiyue so that they can live in harmony and not become a scourge to the south of the Han Dynasty. South Vietnam borders Changsha to the north. During the post-Gao period, officials from relevant departments requested that South Vietnam be prohibited from purchasing ironware in border markets. Zhao Tuo said: Emperor Gao made me the king of South Vietnam, and the two sides exchanged envoys and supplies. Now Gao Hou listens to the opinions of the slanderers, treats the barbarians as aliens, and cuts off the source of the artifacts we need. This must be the idea of ​​King Changsha. He wants to follow the Han Dynasty in the Central Plains, eliminate South Vietnam, double as the king of South Vietnam, and establish his own merits. So Zhao Tuo took advantage of the title and called himself Emperor Wu of Nanyue. He sent troops to attack the border cities of Changsha and defeated several counties before leaving. Empress Gao sent General Longlu Hou Zhou Zao to attack Zhao Tuo. In the hot and humid climate, most of the soldiers became seriously ill, making it impossible for the army to cross Yangshan Mountains. More than a year later, Queen Gao died, and the Han army stopped attacking. Therefore, Zhao Tuo relied on his army to show off his power on the border, and bribed Minyue, Xiou and Luoyue with property to make them all belong to South Vietnam, making his territory more than 10,000 miles long from east to west.

source: Tian Dan is the distant descendant of the Tian family in Qi State. During the reign of King Qi Min, Tian Dan served as a minor official in charge of the municipal administration in Linyi City, the capital, and was not reused by the King of Qi. Later, Yan State sent general Le Yi to attack Qi State, and King Qi Min was forced to flee from the capital, and soon retreated to Jucheng. When the Yan army marched in to conquer Qi, Tian Dan also left the capital and fled to Anping. He asked his people to saw off all the protruding parts of the axles at both ends and wrap them in iron sheets. Soon, the Yan army besieged Anping again, and the city was breached. The Qi people scrambled to escape. Many people were captured by the Yan army because their axles were broken. Only Tian Dan and his clansmen were able to escape because they wrapped the axle with iron hoops and retreated eastward to Jimo. At this time, the Yan army had surrendered all the cities of Qi, and only two cities, Ju and Jimo, had not yet been conquered. When the Yan army heard that King Qi Min was in Jucheng, they gathered their troops and attacked Jucheng with all their strength. Minister Nao Chi killed King Qi Min in Jucheng and defended the city against the Yan army. The Yan army did not break the city for several years. As a last resort, General Yan could only lead his troops eastward and besiege Jimo. The officials guarding the city of Jimo went out to fight with the Yan army, but were defeated and killed. The soldiers and civilians in Jimo City elected Tian Dan as their leader, saying: In the battle of Anping, Tian Dan and his fellow tribesmen were able to escape safely because they wrapped the axles with iron hoops, which shows that he knows the art of war. Therefore, everyone supported Tian Dan as general, defended Jimo, and resisted the Yan army. Not long after, King Yan Zhao died and King Yan Hui came to the throne. There was a rift between him and Le Yi. After Tian Dan heard the news, he sent people to Yan State to implement countermeasures and threatened: King Qi Min has been killed, and there are only two Qi State cities that have not been conquered. Le Yi did not dare to return home because he was afraid of being killed by the king. In the name of attacking Qi, he actually wanted to join forces with Qi's troops and become king of Qi. The people of Qi have not yet surrendered, so they are stalling for time and delaying the attack on Jimo in order to wait for the time to mature before claiming the throne. What the people of Qi are worried about is that they are afraid that Yan will send other generals. In that case, Mo City will definitely be destroyed. King Yan Hui thought these words were correct and sent his general Qi Jie to replace Le Yi. As a result, Le Yi fled to Zhao State, and the Yan officers and soldiers were very angry about this.

Now, Qi State has not yet had the ugly reputation of surrendering to Qin State, but it has strong national strength, so I hope that the king will consider it carefully in order to decide on countermeasures. As expected, Wang Xuan of Tang Dynasty arrested Zhao Qi's family members, framed them for committing serious crimes, and killed them all. Zhao Qi then fled in all directions, passing through Jiang, Huai, Hai, and Dai, hiding his name and selling cakes in Beihai City. At this time, Anqiu Sun Song, who was more than 20 years old, saw Zhao Qi while wandering in the city. He thought he was not an ordinary person. He stopped the car and asked Zhao Qi to get in. Zhao Qi's face turned pale with fear. Sun Song then lowered the curtains on the car and ordered the driver to drive away the pedestrians. He asked Zhao Qi quietly: "Looking at you, you are not a cake seller." He also asked Zhao Qi that your face suddenly changed. You either have a serious grudge or you are a desperado. I, Beihai Sun Binshi, have a whole family and can help you. Zhao Qi had always heard of Sun Song's reputation, so he told Sun Song the actual situation and went to Sun's house together. Sun Song first told his mother: When traveling, I gained a good friend. Then he welcomed Zhao Qi to the upper hall and entertained him very cordially. He hid Zhao Qi in the compound wall for several years, and Zhao Qi wrote twenty-three chapters of "Etun Song". Later, all the Tang clans died and the imperial court granted amnesty to Zhao Qi. When the three mansions heard that Zhao Qi was back, they recruited him at the same time.

General He Jin appointed Zhao Qi as the governor of Dunhuang. When they arrived at Xiangwu, Zhao Qi and several newly appointed governors of various counties were captured by the thief Bian Zhang and others. The thief wanted to force Zhao Qi to become the commander, but Zhao Qi used deceit to avoid it and returned to Chang'an.
